D.1.2.5
Rte_Rips_Invoke
[SWS_Rte_89022]
Service Name
Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_Invoke_<SwcBswI>_<CGI>

Std_ReturnType Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_Invoke_<SwcBswI>_<CGI> (
[IN|IN/OUT|OUT] <data_1>,
[IN|IN/OUT|OUT] ...,
[IN|IN/OUT|OUT] <data_n>,
[Std_TransformerError transformerError]
)
Service ID [hex]
0xEC
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Parameters (in)
<data_1>
The Rte_Rips_Invoke API includes zero or more IN, IN/OUT and
OUT parameters according [SWS_Rte_01102] and none in case
of triggers
Parameters (inout)
...
The Rte_Rips_Invoke API includes zero or more IN, IN/OUT and
OUT parameters according [SWS_Rte_01102] and none in case
of triggers
<data_n>
The Rte_Rips_Invoke API includes zero or more IN, IN/OUT and
OUT parameters according [SWS_Rte_01102] and none in case
of triggers
Parameters (out)
transformerError
The OUT parameter transformerError contains the transformer
error which occurred during execution of the transformer chain.
Return value
Std_ReturnType
The return value is used to indicate communication errors.
Description
Rte_Rips_Invoke performs a transformer or cross cluster invocation for clients or trigger
sources.

Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_<SwcBswI>.h
